[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This Vantage Data Centers facility, WA13, is part of Vantages Quincy campus in Grant County, Washington. Per Vantages own official page for Quincy (tier-1 operator source, https://vantage-dc.com/data-center-locations/north-america/quincy-washington/), this campus at 2101 M Street NE, Quincy, WA 98848, totals 775,000 square feet and 89 MW of critical IT load across three data centers, matching the three WA1-numbered rows (WA11, WA12, WA13) this registry tracks at this campus. Because the 89 MW and 775,000 sq ft figures are campus-wide totals across all three buildings, not confirmed as this specific buildings own figure, they are not applied to critical_it_mw. No individual building specific MW, square footage, or certification distinct from the three-building campus total was found published for this specific row this session. A prior research pass on this row consisted mainly of operator-level company history rather than Quincy-specific facts, that operator-level history is retained alongside this facility-specific addition.
